historical_code_variant_checks.conclusion: Neither recovered historical velocity variant reproduces a=430 AU, e=0.78, i=27 deg under explicit AU/yr/Msun units.

geometric_clue.inference_only: A_OUTBOUND lands within about 1e-4 deg of Omega=180 deg and omega=130 deg. These angles are not in the recovered source and are not promoted to provenance.

reproducibility_gaps: No canonical epoch is specified for the phrase current position.
The methodology omits Omega, omega, and mean/true anomaly at a stated epoch.
Recovered historical code contains mutually inconsistent PBH velocities vy=1.0 and vy=0.001 and inconsistent unit setup.
Earth position/epoch is not reported even though Earth-relative coordinates are claimed; annual parallax at about 583 AU can approach 5.9 arcmin.
The stated 576 AU distance differs from the norm of the published Cartesian vector by about 7.14 AU.
5e-5 solar masses is about 16.65 Earth masses, not about 10.

bestiary.OWL: The reported position and a,e,i are geometrically compatible, but provenance is insufficient for a unique time-anchored orbit.
bestiary.HOUND: Distance, mass-label, epoch, and historical-velocity inconsistencies are flagged.
bestiary.SPIDER: All four exact Kepler-consistent state branches are retained rather than silently selecting missing orientation/phase.
bestiary.BELZEBUB: No reconstructed branch is promoted to canonical current state without recovered source code or independently justified epoch/state.
